HOW TO PLAY
1HOLD the KILN to bake bricks. They slide into your STORAGE shed.
2TAP the STORAGE to load a brick onto the crane.
3TAP ANYWHERE when the brick is over the glowing slot.
Keyboard: Space load / drop · hold Shift or K to bake · S shop · Esc close
